verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that 1Password stores one-time passwords for viewing in its apps and Apple Watch. It also shows a CLI, SDKs and a Connect REST API for general programmatic item management. No item documents a CLI command, SDK method or API endpoint that returns the current TOTP code for use in an automated 2FA login, so the general item-access surfaces are only adjacent building blocks and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can fetch a current TOTP code programmatically — via CLI or API — to complete a 2FA login inside an automated workflow
